summary: No installer-harm signals observed in ts-vitest@1.0.9
details: No malicious behavior was observed in this version of ts-vitest. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote code, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, and no silent-relay or backdoor mechanisms are present in the package contents. The package name resembles the popular vitest testing framework, which may cause user confusion, but name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat and this version's code does not perform any installer-harming action.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
